As a full-stack software engineer IV, you will get the opportunity to work on InComm Product Control (IPC) team. In this role, you will focus on creating, enhancing, and redesigning the applications with the most cutting-edge technologies to provide POS-integrated platform, automated decision-making at POR terminals and business intelligence analytic tools. IPC is a specialized division of InComm that provides product lifecycle tracking and returns management solutions for retailers and manufacturers.

Responsibilities

  • Designing, developing, and implementing scalable and robust applications using Java and the Spring framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data) and front-end framework like Vue JS.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including stakeholders, QA engineers, and product managers, to analyze issues, define requirements and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code, adhering to coding standards and best practices.
  • Creating and performing unit, integration, and system testing to ensure application quality and performance.
  • Troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in existing applications.
  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to peers.
  • Maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in the Spring ecosystem and JavaScipt communities.
  • Contributing to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Making technical and team decisions and assuming responsibility for those decisions while keeping management informed.
  • Providing direction, motivating, and supporting a small group of individuals to achieve specific goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
  • 7+ years of proven experience in developing Java applications (1.8 and above), specifically with the Spring framework and Spring Boot in enterprise level scalable, distributed and fault tolerant environments.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases including SQL, stored procedures, and data modeling with MS SQL and/or Oracle.
  • Strong understanding of object relational mapping APIs like Hibernate, JPA and/or myBatis.
  • Advanced knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and Core JavaScript. Proficiency in at least one of modern front-end frameworks like Angular, React, and/or Vue.
  • Practical understanding of developing Restful Microservices Services using Spring boot.
  • Proficient in version control, build management, and issue tracking software (i.e. git, Maven, JIRA)
  • Good working knowledge of Linux/UNIX and/or Windows server.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with containerization technologies and continuous delivery tools (e.g., Docker, Jenkins Pipeline, Kubernetes, Istio, ArgoCD and/or Snyk) is preferred.
  • Experience with SQL Sentry Tool, Dynatrace and/or Splunk is beneficial.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshooting issues.
  • Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment).

Join to apply for the Engenheiro de Projetos de Perfuração - Rio de Janeiro/RJ role at Infotec Brasil

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Concepção de projeto de perfuração;
  • Análise e cadastro de insumos;
  • Análise e elaboração de resumo de ocorrências dos poços de correlação;
  • Elaboração ou avaliação de estudo de geopressões, geomecânica e estimativa de fechamento;
  • Assentar sapatas atendendo às normas de segurança e ao escopo do projeto;
  • Classificar a criticidade de poço;
  • Disponibilização dos insumos para projetos especializados e estimativa de duração e custos;
  • Preenchimento dos dados básicos no sistema de projetos e no de orçamentação;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de estudos de geologia e caracterização biológica do leito marinho;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de diagrama de restrições para operações em poços offshore;
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de documento declaratório de formações com potencial de fluxo;
  • Solicitação de estrutura analítica de projetos (EAP);
  • Solicitação de estudos especializados de perfuração de poços (projetos de revestimento, cabeça de poço, fluidos, BHA, direcional, perfilagem, alargamento e testemunhagem);
  • Solicitação e análise crítica de riser analysis e WSOG;
  • Solicitação de estimativa de duração probabilística da intervenção;
  • Condução de reunião de pré-projeto, de GEP (Grupo de Empreendimento de Poço) de planejamento, GEP de execução e de planejamento integrado de poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões operacionais, de gestão de mudança de seus poços, de CCAPE e CCAPD dos poços por ele projetados e dos eventos de lições aprendidas;
  • Elaboração dos documentos resultantes do projeto de perfuração (dados básicos, resumo executivo de FEL, cronograma executivo de perfuração e book de projetos);
  • Elaboração de documentos para órgãos externos (parceria, ANP e demais órgãos);
  • Preencher o checklist de perfuração em sistema;
  • Suporte ao coordenador de GEP durante toda a execução e passagem de serviço do poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões do poço projetado (como análises de risco e gestão de mudança);
  • Elaboração de análise preliminar de riscos, conforme padrões e normas;
  • Avaliação de sondas quanto otimização a segurança operacional contemplando, mas não limitado aos seguintes itens (Capacidade de corte do BOP, disponibilidade de EDS’s, avaliação do sistema de compensação e de posicionamento dinâmico da unidade e dos obstáculos na locação);
  • Elaboração de gestões de mudança de projeto;
  • Suportar a elaboração do documento de passagem de serviço dos poços (Handover);
  • Suportar a elaboração das análises de envelope operacional e conjunto solidários de barreiras.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Curso de Nível Superior em Engenharia em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC) ou outro órgão do governo federal destinado a esse fim, com registro no respectivo Conselho de Classe.
  • Experiência: Em projeto e/ou execução de perfuração de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

description:
Community Operations Manager, IgniteTech (Remote)

Join to apply for the Community Operations Manager, IgniteTech (Remote) - $200,000/year USD role at Trilogy

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$100.00/hr - $100.00/hr

Most brand communities look busy but don’t actually resolve customer problems. Customers want to self-serve. Nearly 80% try to solve issues on their own and 90% expect an online portal, yet only about 20% of issues are fully resolved in self-service today. The gap is caused by scattered knowledge, weak configuration, and no ownership, so conversations bounce back into expensive live channels.

We approach the problem like operators, not moderators. Our north star is a high-performing customer community that drives strategic engagement, reduces support load through true self-service, and accelerates customer success. That shows up as three concrete outputs: presentation-ready Community Strategy Reviews anchored to business goals and measurable KPIs, Platform Configuration Packages that ship from staging to prod without drama, and Client Training Sessions that enable teams to self-manage key functions and actually improve capability.

This job is a senior advisor-builder hybrid. About a third of your week will be strategy: discovery with stakeholders, KPI analysis against benchmarks, ruthless prioritization, and a roadmap you can defend to an executive. Another third is configuration: you make the admin console sing, test in staging, deploy cleanly to production, and leave behind clear rationale. The rest is enablement: tailored, live remote sessions with objectives, interactive walkthroughs, live Q&A, and follow-ups that earn >85% satisfaction and unlock self‑reliance. It is not content calendars, social posting, or firefighting moderation queues. It’s not waiting for a playbook and owning outcomes.

You’ll sit with a senior, outcomes‑obsessed team that partners across Customer Success, Support, and Marketing. Your work lands in reduced ticket volume, higher engagement quality, faster time‑to‑value, and platform usage that maps to revenue and retention. If you like blending strategy with hands‑on implementation, then this is where you do the best work of your community career. Apply and help us build communities that carry their own weight.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Community Strategy Reviews: Strategic audits and planning documents assessing community performance against goals, with clear action plans and best‑practice recommendations.
  • Platform Configuration Packages: Bundles of completed admin console changes, such as workflows, gamification, ranks, tags, or moderation tools, tested and deployed from staging to production.
  • Client Training Sessions: Live or asynchronous enablement sessions delivered to client teams covering community operations, best practices, or technical configurations.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Creating content calendars or managing social media posts.
  • Moderating community discussions or handling routine moderation tasks.
  • Working without strategic input or a clear roadmap.
  • Engaging in reactive firefighting instead of proactive strategy.

Community Operations Manager Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a high‑performing customer community that drives strategic customer engagement, reduces support load through self‑service, and accelerates customer success through expert‑led platform optimization and community enablement.

Basic Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience managing or advising digital customer communities
  • Professional experience configuring and administering at least one modern community platform (e.g., Discourse, Higher Logic, Salesforce Experience Cloud, etc.)
  • Professional experience managing enterprise accounts worth at least $1 million
  • Demonstrated experience using AI‑enabled marketing tools or analytics platforms (HubSpot automation, Jasper, Buffer, etc.)
  • Demonstrated understanding of AI's impact on community management and social media

About IgniteTech

World‑class talent. 100% global remote.

Ready to be a part of the top talent that IgniteTech has curated from thousands of applicants throughout the world? Come join us.

Through our portfolio of leading enterprise software solutions, we ignite business performance for thousands of customers globally. We’re big believers in the remote‑work‑from‑anywhere lifestyle, which creates freedom for our team members and enables us to hire the best and brightest from around the world. A career with IgniteTech is challenging and fast‑paced and we’re always looking for energetic and enthusiastic team members.

We’re an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer and we value the strength that diversity brings to our workplace.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

Working with us

This is a full‑time (40 hours per week), long‑term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. This position is responsible for planning scheduled and non‑scheduled heavy maintenance program in an MRO environment. Responsible for forecasting the aircraft turnaround time from routine and non‑routine maintenance perspective when heavy maintenance is being performed. Interacting with different work groups, production, engineering, inspection, inventory planning and supply chain, this position is key to ensure the heavy maintenance execution plan will meet the overall strategy to ensure the aircraft down time is maintained within the established TAT.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Overview

Position: Digital Marketing Specialist
Schedule: Full-time | Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET
Location: Remote (Outside the US)
Salary: USD$1,500/month

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented Digital Marketing Specialist with 2–5 years of experience running and optimizing campaigns across paid channels. You’ll lead digital initiatives that support capital-raising campaigns in real estate, Greentech, and innovation sectors—managing everything from ad strategy and content planning to video editing and performance reporting.

If you know how to drive results through smart execution, collaborative planning, and effective messaging—and have hands-on experience with tools like ChatGPT, Klaviyo, and Adobe Creative Suite—this role could be a perfect fit.

About the Company:
This company is a systematic, data-driven investor acquisition firm focusing on asset management, crowdfunding capital-raising, and real estate. It combines data science, strategic creative, programmatic media, deep industry knowledge, and first-hand experience to change how modern companies raise capital, raise assets under management, and drive their businesses.

We are leaders in assisting with large raises of capital through equity crowdfunding (Reg A+ and Red D). We are not talking Kickstarter here—we mean raises ranging from $25 to $75 million+. We work for a broad range of firms in three areas: yield (mostly real estate related), innovation, and Greentech. The firm’s core is marketing investment products of all kinds, focusing on ETFs (Exchange Traded Funds). We hand-select our clients as much as they select us.

We are an important part of a growing ecosystem and participate in industry events. As well as an equal opportunity employer who values diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Campaign Management – Plan, launch, and optimize digital campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Content Strategy – Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement messaging that aligns with business and campaign goals.
  • Ad Creative Input – Work with writers and designers to ensure copy, visuals, and strategy align with campaign performance goals.
  • AI-Enhanced Marketing – Use ChatGPT and similar tools to brainstorm ideas, generate variations, and streamline campaign execution.
  • Email & SMS Marketing – Manage campaigns through platforms like Klaviyo or Mailchimp, optimizing for engagement and conversions.
  • Website SEO Promotion – Support SEO strategies through digital campaigns that drive high-intent traffic and improve search visibility.
  • Analytics & Reporting – Monitor campaign performance, analyze key metrics, and deliver insights with actionable recommendations.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration – Coordinate with design, content, and project management teams to ensure cohesive and efficient marketing efforts.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience in digital marketing, ideally with campaign ownership.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere and Photoshop.
  • Hands-on experience with Meta, Google, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Experience with email and SMS marketing tools like Klaviyo or Mailchimp.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing principles, targeting strategies, and campaign structure.
  • Familiarity with ChatGPT or similar AI tools to support marketing efficiency and creativity.
  • Excellent English writing and communication skills (short-form copywriting a plus).
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Creative problem-solving and testing mindset.
  • Experience with other video editing or design tools.
  • Working knowledge of SEO and content optimization strategies.
  • Basic HTML/CSS for customizing email templates.
  • Experience using Google Analytics or similar tools for performance tracking.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Fully remote – work from anywhere.
  • Supportive, innovative team culture.
  • High-impact campaigns and measurable outcomes.
  • Your voice matters—great ideas are always welcome.
  • Room to grow as we continue to scale.
  • Must have a professional remote work setup and reliable internet.
  • Strong Zoom presence and communication required - English (C1/C2).
  • As part of the recruitment process, candidates will be asked to submit an introduction video.

JLL has a global IT function which spends over $500 million per annum. All sourcing and procurement needs to be done against the backdrop of JLL governance and S&P guidelines.

Global Category Manager – Software

Develop, manage and execute global category sourcing strategies within the specific IT Category allocated. As the Software Category Manager you will be responsible for building relationships with the CIO’s, CTO’s, Chief Product Officers, building internal demand plans, developing category plans including new opportunities and manage relationships with key strategic suppliers. Ensure contracting and procurement standards are maintained throughout the portfolio.

Summary of essential functions and Goals

  • Partner with the JLLT leadership team to create category strategies that align with JLLT’s key fundamental plans whilst leveraging growing expenditure to have commercial advantage

  • Develops & regularly maintains/up‑dates short-, mid- and long‑term category strategy globally, linking this strategy with overall business strategy/objectives, in alignment with departmental stakeholders (C‑suite)

  • Category Manager has and/or forges key strategic relationships with (strategic) suppliers/industry leaders and develops those relationships on behalf of JLL being mindful of long‑term mutually beneficial and ethical objectives as well as providing the business with access to supplier innovation

  • Category Manager is responsible for leading the approval process for third party expenditure. This includes presenting the deal to senior leaders in the business such as the JLLT CEO, Global CFO and Global CPO

  • Category Manager is leading key strategic procurement projects and provides expert advice and guidance to the JLLT leadership team. Advice has expanded from pricing and commercial principles to incorporate aligning supplier/partner strategies to make/buy decisions & managing sensitivities where JLL’s strategy could create direct conflict against the suppliers value proposition

  • The Category Manager will recommend the qualification of appropriate service providers/supply partners to ensure that we have the best service provision available across the region to deliver value to our internal and sometimes also external clients

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for global category strategy development, execution and category performance of all category related activities & objectives for corporate category requirements as well as other JLL entities if required. Ensuring alignment across the JLLT Leadership team

  • Delivery of financial targets in line with business expectations. Category Manager continuously drives the category opportunity agenda and self‑sufficiently identifies, agrees and executes these projects

  • Accountable for creating strategic solution for specific commodity/service requirements, procurement event planning, RFP/quotation management, bid analysis and recommendations, liaison with internal stakeholders for contract approvals, savings reporting, documentation and compliance.

  • Create and manage the category project calendar, lead category events, bid process, commercial evaluation, recommendations, contract document preparation and functional reviews

  • Approvals according to JLL Delegation of Authority. Compliance with JLL procedures as applicable. This includes presenting and seeking approval from Global CEO of JLLT, Global CPO and Global CFO

  • Rationalizes supply base and develops clear strategic supply partner framework and maintains this framework at senior supplier level

  • Use Global, Regional and Country, market and industry intelligence to identify and qualify new suppliers and use data to support the business and delivery of services. In addition, identify risk, threats and provide solutions for mitigation.

  • Provide functional leadership and peer group alignment, where appropriate and needed

  • Identify opportunities to develop and implement new policies and procedures, including rationalization of legacy policies and procedures

  • Actively engage in and support the use of e‑procurement strategy, methodology and deployment

  • Prepare high quality papers and presentations for use with internal and external stakeholders and/or teams as required

  • Apply ethical company standards and ensure Global Procurement policy is applied at all times

Ability to Manage the Sourcing Process

  • Develop category plan with the ability to provide visibility such as supplier summaries, stakeholder engagement plans, contract summaries, and market insights that lead to both short and long‑term strategies

  • Ability to negotiate and have proven strategies within areas of corporate spend

  • Lead development and execution of all sourcing‑related functions: performing due diligence and assessment of prospective suppliers, executing RFPs/bids, negotiating contracts and ensuring effective transition to operations during implementation

  • Partner with CIO’s and the business to drive both immediate and sustained benefits to JLL Corporate

  • Bring strategic thought leadership to identify additional cost and operational efficiencies. Individual must be able to consider bigger picture goals and scenarios. The individual has to be able to clearly articulate and advise senior members of JLL on decisions that could impact business line performance

  • Proactively manage internal stakeholder expectations and escalation at appropriate times

  • Savings – working with sourcing managers and key suppliers, ensure that savings initiatives ideas are being driven to maximize savings impacts

  • Ensure that the savings tracker across country is kept up‑to‑date for the category so that we can demonstrate value add to our internal stakeholders

  • Conduct Preferred Supplier performance review meetings, manage supplier scorecards, contract compliance and service obligations

  • Subject matter expert for category and considered to be the channel of choice within JLL

Sound like you? To apply you need to have:

  • Excellent Inter‑personal skills, Organization skills, Strong gravitas and influencing skills with senior business leaders

  • Ability work on a global scale and across different regions. This includes the ability to meet and align category plans with global vertical stakeholders

  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written

  • Proven ability to facilitate strategic supplier relationships and work with senior business executives and across procurement leadership

  • Collaborative and influencing style with a focus on team work

  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments

  • Expertise in sourcing with demonstrated ability to manage change

  • Ability to sell and present initiatives and/or new ideas

  • Experience in sourcing indirect corporate services and products

  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in MS applications with excellent ability to work with large amounts of data and build reports

  • Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) from four‑year college university

  • Minimum 7 years of strategic sourcing experience (majority within IT and technology)

  • CPSM certification preferred

  • MBA preferred

Location

  • Role to be based in North America (USA or Canada)

  • As part of the role, individuals must have the flexibility to deal with projects in different time zones and manage their time accordingly

You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture. One where we succeed together – across the desk and around the globe. Where like‑minded people work naturally together to achieve great things.

title: QA Lead (100% Remote)
description:
About the Job
QA Lead is responsible for overseeing the quality assurance function across Tether Data. This role ensures that product releases meet defined quality standards through the development and execution of test strategies, frameworks, and automation. QA Lead works closely with the teams, Dev‑Ops and Product to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
QA Lead serves as the quality champion within Tether Data and plays a key role in shaping the overall testing culture and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Define and Drive QA Strategy: Establish and continuously refine the overall QA vision, goals, and strategy to align with product and engineering objectives, balancing manual and automated testing approaches.
  • Plan and Manage Testing Activities: Oversee test planning, prioritization, and execution across projects. Ensure test coverage aligns with business impact, release timelines, and risk assessment.
  • Mentor and Guide QA Engineers: Provide technical and procedural guidance to QA Engineers, fostering skill development in both manual and automation testing. Conduct regular reviews and coaching sessions.
  • Ensure Quality Governance and Standards: Define QA processes, templates, and best practices to standardize testing across teams. Maintain consistency in documentation, defect management, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Work closely with product managers, developers, and DevOps to ensure quality is embedded throughout the SDLC. Participate in planning and other ceremonies where applicable to provide support and guidance.
  • Oversee Test Automation Strategy: Guide the design, maintenance, and optimization of automation frameworks. Ensure automation coverage is effective, scalable, and well-integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage Test Environments and Data: Coordinate environment setup, data preparation, and version control to ensure test consistency and reliability across manual and automated executions.
  • Monitor and Report on Quality Metrics: Define and track key QA KPIs (e.g., defect density, test coverage, pass rate, release readiness). Use insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate Release Readiness and Risk Assessment: Lead go/no‑go decisions based on test outcomes, quality metrics, and known issues. Communicate quality status and risks clearly to stakeholders.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement: Evaluate tools, processes, and team performance to identify opportunities for efficiency and quality enhancement. Champion a culture of learning and proactive defect prevention.
  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including both manual and automation testing.
  • 3+ years of proven experience leading QA teams or managing QA processes across multiple projects.
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and SDLC/Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Java, C#).
  • Proven experience in leading the design and execution of QA strategies across multiple projects.
  • Strong proficiency in planning, scheduling, prioritizing, and coordinating testing activities across teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud environments and containerization (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Certifications: ISTQB Advanced Level, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent QA leadership certification

title: Sr. Site Manager – Sr. CRA (Clinical Research Associate)
description:
Job Function

R&D Operations

Job Sub Function

Clinical Trial Support

Job Category

Professional

All Job Posting Locations

São Paulo, Brazil

Job Description

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at

Purpose

A Senior, Site Manager is a mid‑level site management role with typically 3‑5 years of experience. This role serves as the primary contact point between the Sponsor and the Investigational Site. A Senior, Site Manager is assigned to trial sites to ensure inspection readiness through compliance with the clinical trial protocol, company SOPs, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulations and guidelines from study start‑up through to site closure. Responsibilities may include assisting with site selection, site qualification assessment, subject recruitment and retention planning, site initiation, on‑site and remote monitoring and close‑out activities. The Senior, Site Manager will partner with the Local Trial Manager (LTM), Clinical Trial Assistant (CTA) and TDL (Trial Delivery Leader) to ensure overall site management while performing trial related activities for assigned protocols. A Senior, Site Manager may contribute to process improvement, training and mentoring of other Site Managers. A Senior, Site Manager is generally expected to be able to operate independently with little or limited supervision.

Principal Responsibilities

  1. Acts as primary local company contact for assigned sites for specific trials.
  2. Actively may participate in site feasibility and/or Site Qualification Visit.
  3. Attends/participates in investigator meetings as needed, may be expected to help prepare meeting materials and may be required to present at the IM.
  4. Responsible for executing activities within site initiation and start‑up, preparation and conduct of site monitoring (including remote monitoring), site management (by study specific systems and other reports/dashboards) and site/study close‑out according to SOPs, Work Instructions (WIs) and policies. Responsible for the implementation of analytical risk‑based monitoring model at the site level and to work with site to ensure timely resolution of issues found during monitoring visits. Able to implement and execute all tasks independently with little or limited supervision.
  5. Ensures site staff are trained and the corresponding training records are complete and accurate at any time point during all trial phases. Responsible in close collaboration with LTM and central study team for the activities during site activation phase in order to speed up the process and activate the site in shortest possible timeframe. May be required to help provide solutions to challenges faced in other sites in the country.
  6. Contributes to site level recruitment strategy and contingency planning and implementation in partnership with other functional areas.
  7. Ensures site study supplies (such as Non‑Investigational Product (IP), lab kits, etc.) are adequate for trial conduct.
  8. Ensures that clinical drug supplies are appropriately used, handled and stored and returns are accurately inventoried and documented.
  9. Arranges for the appropriate destruction of clinical supplies.
  10. Ensures site staff complete data entry and resolve queries within expected timelines.
  11. Ensures accuracy, validity and completeness of data collected at trial sites.
  12. Proactively ensures that all Adverse Events (AE)/Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)/Product Quality Complaints (PQCs) are reported within the required reporting timelines and documented as appropriate. For AEs/SAEs, ensures that they are consistent with all data collected and with the information in the source documents.
  13. Maintains complete, accurate and timely data and essential documents in relevant systems utilized for trial management.
  14. Fully documents trial related activities, in particular monitoring. Writes visit reports and follow‑up letter in accordance with the SOPs. Promptly communicates relevant status information and issues to appropriate stakeholders.
  15. Reviews study files for completeness and ensures archiving retention requirements are met, including storage in a secure area at all times.
  16. Collaborates with LTM for documenting and communicating site/study progress and issues to trial central team.
  17. Attends regularly scheduled team meetings and trainings.
  18. Complies with relevant training requirements. Act as local expert in assigned protocols. Possesses proficient therapeutic knowledge sufficient to support role and responsibilities.
  19. Works closely with LTM to ensure Corrective Action Preventative Action (CAPA) is completed for Quality Assurance (QA) site audits and for quality issues identified at the site during routine monitoring and other visit types, e.g. Compliance Monitoring Visit (CMV). May be required to oversee audit and inspection preparation by Associate SM.
  20. Prepares trial sites for close out, conduct final close out visit.
  21. Tracks costs at site level and ensure payments are made, if applicable.
  22. Establishes and maintains good working relationships with internal and external stakeholders in particular investigators, trial coordinators and other site staff.
  23. May participate in the Health Authority (HA) and IEC/IRB submission and notification processes as required/appropriate.
  24. Acts as a point of contact in site management practices. Able to provide credible and useful insights and input.
  25. On need basis may be assigned as a coach and mentor to a less experienced site manager.
  26. May be required to contribute to process improvement and training.
  27. Occasionally leads and/or participates in special initiatives as assigned.
  28. May be required to assume additional responsibilities or special initiatives such as “Champion” or Subject Matter Expert.”

Education and Experience Requirements

  • A minimum of a BA or BS degree in Pharmacy, Nursing, Life Sciences or related scientific field (or equivalent experience) is required.
  • A minimum of 2 years of clinical trial monitoring experience is required. 3‑5 years of clinical trial monitoring experience is preferred, however, other relevant experiences and skills may be considered by the hiring manager when considering the candidate’s eligibility.
  • Specific therapeutic area experience may be required depending on the position and is an added advantage.
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP, company SOPs, local laws and regulations, assigned protocols and associated protocol specific procedures including monitoring guidelines.
  • Strong IT skills in appropriate software and company systems. Willingness to travel with occasional overnight stay away from home.
  • Proficient in speaking and writing the country language and English. Good written and oral communication.
  • Ability to work on multiple trials in parallel.
  • Demonstrated capability to consistently deliver clinical trials.
  • Demonstrated capability to effectively communicate and engage with sites and sites personnel.
  • Demonstrated problem solving capability.

Programa Talento Inovação – IEL Paraná

O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.

Projeto: Futuro da Beleza – Vaga afirmativa

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

Sobre a Oportunidade – Grupo Boticário

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Formação Acadêmica

Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Idioma

Inglês – Nível avançado (leitura).

Principais Atividades

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.

Conhecimento Necessário

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade em busca de informações;

Join Our Team as a Regional Intake Manager

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Regional Intake Manager to lead and inspire our multi-state Intake teams. In this pivotal role, you will lead the patient intake journey end-to-end by optimizing workflows, ensuring seamless onboarding of new patients, and fostering cross-department collaboration to deliver exceptional patient experiences.

We’re looking for a leader with a proven record of operational excellence, including setting and achieving ambitious Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), implementing process improvements, and developing high-performing teams. This position is ideal for someone who thrives on strategic thinking, data-driven decision-making, and hands-on leadership to elevate both team performance and patient care.

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every team member supports our shared mission. You may be called upon to participate in projects and initiatives beyond the scope of this description, and you are expected to model and champion our core values every day.

Compensation: $85,000 - 110,000 annually, with additional annual bonus potential

Location: Remote
Monday-Friday

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership

  • Act as the primary liaison between Intake, local offices, clinical leadership, and internal departments to drive process improvements and ensure efficient operations.
  • Collaborate with Division leadership and Business Development to strengthen referral relationships and align Intake KPIs with broader marketing and business strategies.
  • Champion new technologies and process enhancements, leading teams through organizational change with clarity and confidence.

Team Development & Management

  • Recruit, coach, and mentor managers and frontline staff, cultivating a high performing, engaged team with clear career paths.
  • Conduct regular team meetings, one on one meetings, and quality assurance assessments, fostering open communication and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee employee performance reviews, coaching, and development plans while ensuring compliance with company and departmental policies.
  • Partner with the training department to maintain up-to-date onboarding and ongoing education for all Intake staff.
  • Build engagement strategies to reduce attrition, promote a culture of belonging, and identify emerging leaders to create an employee pipeline across the intake team and organization.

Operational Excellence & Metrics

  • Design and refine intake workflows to optimize efficiency and elevate the patient onboarding experience.
  • Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance using Intake technology (phone, email, work-item queues, and EHR systems).
  • Establish, track, and analyze KPIs, providing regular performance reports and actionable insights to senior leadership.
  • Develop and manage staffing models to meet service-level goals, balancing forecasted demand, workforce capacity, and budget considerations.
  • Proactively assess operational risks, ensuring HIPAA and regulatory compliance across all intake processes.

Customer & Patient Experience

  • Address escalated patient concerns promptly and effectively, collaborating with staff and providers to ensure resolution.
  • Encourage the adoption of innovative practices and continuous learning to meet evolving industry standards and patient needs.
  • Participate in Intake department workflows as needed to maintain service quality and demonstrate hands-on leadership.

REQUIREMENTS

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s in healthcare administration, business, or related field preferred.
  • In lieu of a degree, 5+ years of progressive management experience in a healthcare-related field will be considered.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing multi-location and remote teams of 50+ employees in a healthcare.
  • 3+ years of contact center operations leadership with a clear understanding of telephony, workforce optimization, and quality oversight.
  • 3+ years of healthcare operations experience, preferably within medical or behavioral health settings.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and contact center technologies; experience with Observe.AI and NICE (or similar telephony/workforce tools) strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of medical and commercial insurance terminology and intake-related workflows.
  • Advanced data literacy, including ability to build and interpret performance dashboards and translate insights into actionable improvements.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Teams, and Power BI; proven ability to quickly learn and adapt to new platforms and systems, troubleshoot basic technical issues independently in a remote environment, and leverage these tools for efficient remote operations.

Leadership & People Management

  • Proven success developing high-performing managers and teams, driving accountability, and engaging remote and hybrid staff.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills; proven ability to influence across departments and at the executive level.
  • Track record of process optimization and change leadership, including large-scale initiatives or technology implementations.

Customer & Patient Experience

  • Strong commitment to customer service excellence with experience handling escalated concerns and maintaining a patient-first mindset.

Analytical & Strategic Skills

  • Proven ability to establish, monitor, and exceed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while identifying opportunities through data analysis and implementing measurable strategies for improvement.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and executive-level presentations.

Adaptability & Work Environment

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, balancing strategic priorities with hands-on operational needs.
  • Quiet, distraction-free, HIPAA-compliant home workspace.
  • Remote position with occasional in-person meetings (approx. 10% travel).

Culture & Compliance

title: Store Setup Lead
description:
Job Description

Store Setup Team Leads assist their supervisor and other Store Setup leads with the merchandising of new, remodeled and relocated Advance Auto Parts stores. Team leads are responsible for individual parts of the larger project plan, to set a store to be ready for open. They lead a portion of the local team or contracted support staff to complete segments of the store. As an example, a Team Lead will Co-lead store team members and contracted support that are completing activities on the retail sales floor, while another Team Lead is responsible for leading merchandising activities in the areas behind the retail counters. A Store Setup team consists of one Supervisor, and three SSU Leads reporting to them.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Other duties may be assigned.

  • Co-leads teams of local Advance Auto Parts Retail Team Members and contracted support to successfully set up a new a portion of an Advance Auto Parts, Carquest, or other acquired companies stores/branches to company and department standards
  • Trainslocal team members and contract support on proper merchandising techniques. Helps direct them in their day-to-day assignments
  • Builds Gondolas and Backroom storage shelving according to floor plan.
  • Directs all work related to their segment of the project.
  • Must document (written) any noncompliance with company policy or procedure by an employee within forty-eight (48) hours of occurrence and notify their Store Setup Supervisor (contact supervisor or Human Resource if in doubt)
  • Must be willing to travel 80-100% of the time
  • Reconciling travel and business-related expenses

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Co-leads 2-10 internal or outsourced team members during assignments. Is responsible for assisting in the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the team. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include - Interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
  • To maintain a positive attitude, set a professional example, and promote proper work ethics for team members and operations personnel at all times to follow.
  • Must be comfortable leading in a matrixed environment
  • Verify all plan-o-grams are correct, current and built to plan. This includes signage, display racks, and specialty display items. Any errors in plan-o-gram accuracy should be reported to the plan-o-gram department and fixed on site.
  • Is responsible for keeping expenses to a minimum following department and company guidelines. This includes motel, travel, meals, tools, supplies and payroll.

QUALIFICATIONS - To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); 2-4 years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers, Outsourced reps or employees of organization.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Must be willing to be certified as a forklift operator

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be able to travel as store schedule requires. Travel may require being away from home for 8 to twelve days at a time. Typical schedule is 8 days but can vary depending on project type.
  • Must comply with all company policies and procedures and set a professional example.
  • Follow all security and safety practices at all times

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb ladders or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and color vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to high, precarious places. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions, extreme cold, and extreme heat. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

ABOUT INEVENT

InEvent is an innovative and fast‑paced B2B startup that develops intelligent solutions for hospitality and marketing within large enterprises, creating high‑level management for the C‑level suite and robust operational tools for analysts and managers.

WHO WE ARE

InEvent is a remote event tech company with InEventers in over 13 different countries, speaking together more than 27 different languages. We are a global team.

InEventers are a unique team, with a shared Vision of growth and Values. We allow you to be yourself, and we encourage open communication. The most important thing here is not your experience, but your curiosity and passion to learn and grow with us!

HR GENERALIST

InEvent is looking for an experienced HR Generalist to provide support to InEventers with HR‑related matters and who is fascinated by building a hiring pipeline process.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as an advisor in all matters of employee relations and engagement;
  • Lead full‑cycle recruitment within a broad and complex portfolio of business roles;
  • Play a key role in forecasting and planning conversations, lead recruitment‑related projects, and apply expertise to build strong relationships with managers;
  • Interview, evaluate, and match skilled professionals to InEvent requirements;
  • Prepare monthly recruitment reports;
  • Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date HR/ personnel records and manage the HRIS;
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of human resources processes, by analyzing various departmental needs, and ensuring alignment with strategies, policies, and processes.
  • Contribute to the authoring and editing of InEvent policies and other admin functions;
  • Liaise with the Marketing and Talent Acquisition Teams to redesign and manage our social media pages with visuals that represent our company;
  • Developing and executing candidate‑facing communication on social media and Job Recruitment sites by establishing social media and online recruiting campaigns;
  • Designing and implementing branding strategies to develop brand awareness;
  • Provide strategic support to the Talent Acquisition sector of Human Resources in the areas of culture, values, engagement, and talent attraction;
  • Assist in people management processes such as onboarding, performance management, benefits, welfare, vacations, terminations, and others.

PRE-REQUISITES

  • Must speak English and Portuguese fluently;
  • 2+ years experience in HR roles, with a focus on employee relations and branding;
  • Experience with HRIS;
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and discretion;
  • Experience with hiring;
  • Creative thinking and the ability to develop innovative employer brand initiatives;
  • Familiarity with digital marketing tools and social media platforms;
  • Be responsible, have a sense of urgency, and initiative;
  • Detail‑oriented with strong organizational and time‑management abilities;
  • Resilient to learn continuously in a startup;
  • Exceptional communicator, both written and verbal;
  • Must have a personal notebook (Mac or Windows);
  • Must have a mobile device (iOS or Android).

PERKS

  • Global Health Insurance;
  • Paid Time Off (PTO);
  • Annual Summits;
  • Birthday Gift and Work Anniversary Gifts.

CONTRACT

This is a Permanent, Full‑time position (40h per week), on an Independent Contractor status.

If you think this position is for you, bring along your personal notebook (Mac or Windows) and a mobile device (iOS or Android) and come work with us!

  • Experiência em configuração e customização de conectores e workflows no IdentityNow.
  • Proficiência em Java, BeanShell, XML, JSON, APIs REST/SOAP e SCIM .
  • Experiência com linguagens de script como PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Sólido entendimento de serviços de diretório e plataformas de identidade em nuvem.

  • Fortes habilidades de troubleshooting em desafios de IAM.
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente para contato diário com times globais.

  • Familiaridade com scripting em Graph API para automação de identidades.

  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e ferramentas DevOps para deploys de IAM.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de compliance regulatório (ex.: SOX, GDPR ).

Qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, TI, Cibersegurança ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).

PROJETISTA ELETROMECÂNICO DE LINHAS DE TRANSMISSÃO - RIO DE JANEIRO

SOBRE A NIP DO BRASIL
Somos uma empresa de engenharia consultiva especializada em soluções para infraestrutura, energia e meio ambiente. Atuamos com inovação, precisão técnica e responsabilidade socioambiental. Nossa missão é transformar desafios em soluções sustentáveis, gerando impacto positivo para o Brasil e suas comunidades.

Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, inclusivo e focado no desenvolvimento humano. Na NIP, cada pessoa tem espaço para crescer e contribuir com propósito.

Missão da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais. Contribuir de forma estratégica para o desempenho dos projetos da NIP, liderando entregas técnicas, interações com clientes e acompanhando a equipe de engenharia.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Levantar dados preliminares de campo e referências técnicas (topografia, georreferenciamento, interferências, servidões, condicionantes ambientais).
  • Definir traçado da linha, escolher o melhor percurso considerando restrições técnicas, ambientais e custos, com otimização de rota.
  • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.
  • Projetar estruturas de sustentação (torres, postes), definindo tipologia, perfis, empenos, cargas de vento, gelo (quando aplicável) e requisitos de fabricação.
  • Projetar fundações para torres / postes com base nos levantamentos geotécnicos e cargas atuantes.
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos e memoriais de cálculo que detalhem hipóteses adotadas, normas aplicadas, critérios de dimensionamento e justificativas técnicas.
  • Produzir desenhos executivos e detalhamentos (plantas, cortes longitudinais e transversais, arranjos, fixações, grampos, emendas).
  • Definir o sistema de aterramento das estruturas e condutores, malha de terra compatível com segurança elétrica e regulamentos.
  • Realizar compatibilização técnica com disciplinas complementares (civil, proteção, telecomunicações, automação), garantindo integração dos projetos.
  • Aplicar e garantir conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais (ABNT, IEC, normas de concessionárias) e regulamentos setoriais.
  • Adaptar projetos conforme requisitos contratuais de clientes ou exigências de concessionárias / clientes, acompanhando revisões e solicitações.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes, fornecedores, órgãos reguladores e equipes de obra para alinhamento de soluções, esclarecimento de dúvidas e decisões de projeto.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas de projeto, distribuir tarefas entre equipe de projetistas, revisar entregas, monitorar prazos e qualidade técnica.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais para acompanhamento de status do projeto, performance da equipe, indicadores de progresso e apoio à gestão.
  • Apoiar a execução da obra fornecendo suporte técnico, esclarecimentos de campo, checagem de conformidade entre projeto e execução e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Garantir que o projeto atenda requisitos de confiabilidade, manutenibilidade, durabilidade e segurança elétrica ao longo do ciclo de vida da linha.

Requisitos Técnicos

Escolaridade / Qualificação Desejada: Técnico em Eletrotécnica

  • Técnico em Eletrônica ou Eletroeletrônica
  • Técnico em Desenho de Projetos ou Técnico em Edificações (com experiência em projetos elétricos)
  • Technólogo em Sistemas Elétricos, Energias Renováveis ou Projetos Industriais
  • Desejável Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Engenharia Eletromecânica ou Engenharia de Energia.
  • Conhecimentos Avançados em softwares de cálculo e modelagem elétrica/mecânica (ex: Autocad, PLS‑CADD, MATLAB, AutoCAD, ferramentas de análise de estruturas).
  • Residir em Fortaleza - CE;
  • Nível avançado em PLS-CADD;
  • Nível intermediário em Excel.

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde Unimed Nacional (empresa cobre 80%, colaborador 20%)
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós‑graduação)
  • TotalPass (academias)
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Seguro de Vida

Compromisso com a Diversidade

A NIP do Brasil valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas. Todas as candidaturas são bem‑vindas, independentemente de gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, religião, idade ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é construir um ambiente onde todos possam prosperar.

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes.

Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo.

Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.

Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Conversar com clientes internos, fornecedores, e parceiros para entender contextos e dar vazão para cada situação.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimentos intermediários de programação em Python outras linguagens.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados e APIs REST/WebService.

  • Conhecimentos básicos de administração de redes (cabeadas, WiFi, VPNs).
  • Inglês intermediário (boa leitura e escrita, conversação básica).
  • Conhecimento de administração do Google Workspace (antigo GSuite) e suas ferramentas.
  • Conhecimento de IA.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros;
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto;
  • Se nós crescemos, nossos Qivers também vem com a gente! Temos um Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos;
  • Ajuda de custo ao qiver nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00 avançados;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade;
  • Total Pass;
  • Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios;
  • Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país;
  • Enviamos todos os equipamentos necessários para montar o seu escritório em casa, mas se você preferir temos uma sede com estacionamento gratuito, lanches e bebidas liberadas e um ambiente super descontraído.;
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, incentivando o crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar, por isso temos aulas online e gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Pensando na saúde mental e no desenvolvimento, também temos parceiros como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive

Estamos em constante aprendizado para garantir que todas as pessoas possuam liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir e sentir em seu dia a dia as experiências positivas apresentadas pela Qive! Isso é mais do que resolver uma dor em comum, queremos ser melhores sempre, queremos mudar o jogo seja ele qual for. E contamos com você para fazer a diferença e isso independe de sua crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais

Em nossos processos seletivos coletamos e tratamos os dados pessoais fornecidos no formulário de candidatura da vaga (o que inclui tanto os dados informados em cada campo do formulário, quanto os que estiverem presentes no currículo anexado) e dados que podem ser solicitados nas próximas etapas. A Qive não terá acesso a nenhum outro dado que esteja fora destas hipóteses. A finalidade de coleta é tão somente para identificação, comunicação e análise das pessoas candidatas.

Informamos ainda que realizamos toda a gestão das vagas por meio do sistema InHire, não possuindo vínculo com outras plataformas em que as nossas vagas são espelhadas. Logo, caso você esteja se candidatando às nossas vagas por um meio que não seja o nosso site oficial ou pela InHire, recomenda-se a leitura dos termos e políticas próprias de cada um.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

About The Role

Ruby Labs is looking for a Senior Conversion Strategist – someone who lives and breathes conversion optimization and delivers measurable results. In this role, you'll have a clear mission: deliver 15% conversion rate growth in a quarter.

Unlike companies where Conversion specialists simply make recommendations, you'll drive the entire process: from data analysis and hypothesis generation to creating high‑fidelity mockups, collaborating with developers on implementation, and ultimately owning the performance outcomes.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:

Interview Process

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. Purpose and Objectives

We are excited to announce an opportunity to join the Consumption Controlling team within the Cloud Controlling CoE — a newly found team focusing on strategically important consumption-based business models like C2C, Public Cloud, or AI. This team will set the foundation for successful forecasting, steering and reporting of SAP’s most prominent deals as well as business models of the future by providing exceptional reporting, analysis and governance across end-to-end finance and revenue processes.

We are looking for a highly motivated, detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive team player to help prevent revenue leakage , support revenue sensitive closing activities , and ensure the completeness and accuracy of C2C and consumption revenue. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of Controlling, Revenue Recognition, R2R, O2I and Operations — identifying financial risks, implementing controls, and supporting internal audits and compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Assurance & Leakage Prevention

  • Design and execute controls to ensure revenue completeness and validate usage, pricing, and billing against contractual terms
  • Analyze usage, billing, and contractual data to validate financial inputs and identify discrepancies
  • Investigate and resolve root causes of revenue leakage
  • Partner with stakeholders to implement improvements that reduce financial risk

Closing and Reporting Activities

  • Support key closing activities (MEC/QEC/YEC) that impact revenue recognition, ensuring data integrity and accuracy
  • Ensure revenue inputs are complete and reliable during financial close
  • Maintain audit readiness and support SOX compliance related to revenue streams
  • Collaborate with Controlling, CFR, R2R, and O2I teams to align upstream and downstream data flows
  • Coordinate with audit and compliance teams for reporting and control validation

Governance and Process Collaboration

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure aligned and standardized processes across the revenue lifecycle
  • Contribute to cross-functional projects aimed at improving financial accuracy and automation
  • Document and continuously improve processes to enhance scalability and audit readiness

Qualification and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Accounting, or comparable degree
  • Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles (especially for consumption/SaaS models)
  • Experience in Revenue Assurance, Financial Controlling, or Audit
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a problem-solving mindset
  • Resilient under pressure, with the ability to manage high volumes of complex information
  • Proactive, self-driven, and committed to a continuous improvement mindset (zero-repeat culture)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to navigate cross-functional environments
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with SAP (e.g., RAR, CO/FI) is a plus
  • Experience with automation and data tools (e.g., KNIME, SAC, AI-assisted analysis) is an advantage
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)

Company Overview

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development.

Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

We win with inclusion. SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

About the Role

You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.

• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

description:
Join to apply for the Senior Applications Analyst - LATAM role at Siemens Energy

A Snapshot of Your Day

You start your day by reviewing the health and performance of key enterprise applications across LATAM. You collaborate with cross‑functional teams and external vendors to ensure seamless operations, compliance, and continuous improvement. You lead meetings with regional stakeholders and engage with global teams to align on strategic initiatives. Your analytical mindset and technical expertise help resolve complex issues and drive innovation in application management.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Lead the governance and performance of application support vendors across LATAM.
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity and audit standards for enterprise applications.
  • Support business requirements and IT projects, enabling digital transformation.
  • Manage application interfaces and integrations involving SAP, RFC, EDI, and SnapLogic.
  • Knowledge of SAP MM and SD modules is a plus.
  • Monitor and report on application KPIs, ensuring alignment with business goals.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and documentation to support operational excellence and scalability.
  • Contribute to strategic planning and roadmap development for application portfolios in LATAM.
  • Lead application onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal disruption.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in application lifecycle management, vendor governance, and audit support. Hands‑on experience with enterprise applications in regional and global environments.
  • Certifications such as PMP, Scrum Master, ITIL, or similar are a plus.
  • Advanced proficiency in Portuguese and English. Intermediate Spanish is required.
  • Candidates from energy, manufacturing, or other complex enterprise environments are welcome.
  • Availability to travel across LATAM and internationally (up to 20% of the time).

About The Team

You will be part of a dynamic and multicultural regional team that collaborates closely with global stakeholders. The team supports enterprise applications across LATAM, ensuring operational excellence, compliance, and innovation. With a strong focus on collaboration and continuous improvement, the team plays a critical role in enabling business success through technology. The environment is fast‑paced, diverse, and offers opportunities to work on impactful projects with global visibility.

Who is Siemens Energy

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy:

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Benefits

  • Opportunities to work with a global team
  • Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
  • Medical benefits
  • Remote/Flexible work
  • Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave
  • Continual learning through the ‑Energy platform
  • Access to a variety of employee resource groups
